My goal is to maximize the total money I’ll earn over one year — that means the interest I earn minus any annual fees. Can you help me find the best combination?

# Light Blue Account at a glance

## Quick facts
- APY on your balance: 0%
- Daily mobile check deposit limit: $2,000
- Early direct deposit: 0 day(s) before payday

## Notes
- If you plan to deposit multiple checks in one day, track your total to stay within the $2,000 daily limit.
- This account offers 0 day(s) early access to direct deposits.

# Light Blue Account specifications and requirements

## Account specifications
- Annual Percentage Yield (APY): 0%
- Debit card daily purchase limit: $2,500

## Managing your debit card limit
- Plan large purchases so the total stays within $2,500 for a single day.
- If you anticipate a purchase above $2,500, contact us in advance to discuss options for completing your transaction.

## Tips for smooth purchases
- Split transactions only when the merchant allows separate authorizations.
- Keep an eye on pending card transactions, as they count toward the $2,500 until they settle or drop off.

# Light Blue Account features and fees

## Fees and features
| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Monthly maintenance fee | $0.00 |
| Overdraft fee | $0.00 |
| Overdraft protection transfer fee | $0.00 |
| Free out-of-network ATM withdrawals per month | 2 |
| Out-of-network ATM withdrawal fee (after free) | $2.50 |
| Paper statement fee (monthly) | $0.00 |
| Returned deposit fee | $0.00 |
| Incoming domestic wire fee | $0.00 |
| Stop payment fee (per request) | $30 |
| APY on balances | 0% |
| Daily ATM withdrawal limit | $400 |

## Out-of-network ATM withdrawals
- You receive 2 free out-of-network ATM withdrawals each month.
- After using your free allowance, each additional withdrawal costs $2.50.
- ATM owners may charge their own surcharge, separate from our fee.

## Daily ATM withdrawal limit
- Your daily ATM withdrawal limit is $400. This limit applies to all ATM withdrawals within a 24-hour period.

## Helpful notes
- Returned checks may be subject to the $0.00 even if the return reason is outside your control.
- If you prefer paper statements, factor in the $0.00 each cycle.
- If you link an account for overdraft protection, each transfer to cover a shortfall is $0.00.

# Diamond Elite Savings Account: Complete Guide

## What you earn
- Your balance accrues at 7.5%.

## Deposits
- Mobile check deposits are permitted up to $100,000 per day.

## Transfers and payments
- You can transfer out up to $500,000 per day.
- External bank transfers complete in 0 business days.
- All wire transfer fees are waived: Yes.

## Withdrawals
- Withdrawals are not capped monthly. The system reflects this as -1.

## Fees
- Monthly maintenance fee: $0.00.
- Wire transfer fees: Yes.

## Dedicated service
- Access to a dedicated private banker is available: Yes.

## Advisory and planning
- Complimentary investment advisory is included: Yes.

## Events and experiences
- Invitations to exclusive events are provided: Yes.

## Quick reference
| Category | Detail |
|---|---|
| APY | 7.5% |
| Mobile deposit daily limit | $100,000 |
| Max daily outbound transfers | $500,000 |
| Monthly maintenance fee | $0.00 |
| Monthly withdrawal limit | -1 |
| External transfer processing time | 0 business days |
| Wire transfer fees | Yes |
| Private banker access | Yes |

# Platinum Account at a glance

## Key figures
- APY: 6.5%
- Minimum balance to maintain account: $50,000
- Extended FDIC insurance available through partner banks: Yes

## Quick insights
- Maintain the required balance to retain Platinum benefits.
- If extended insurance is available to you, enrollments and allocations are coordinated for you after you opt in.

# FAQ: Platinum Plus Account

## Frequently asked questions
- What APY do I earn on my balance?
  - You earn 7.0% APY.

- What minimum balance must I maintain?
  - The required minimum balance is $100,000.

- Is there a monthly maintenance fee if I don't meet the minimum balance?
  - The monthly maintenance fee is $50.00.

- Are wire transfer fees waived?
  - Wire transfer fees are waived: Yes.

- Does the account include concierge travel services?
  - Concierge travel services included: Yes.

# Silver Plus: Differences from Silver Account

## What changes with Silver Plus

### Tiered APY
- Silver Plus offers tiered APY with two levels:
  - Tier 1 APY: 3.0% for balances below the Tier 2 threshold.
  - Tier 2 APY: 4.5% for balances at or above the Tier 2 threshold.

### Withdrawal flexibility
- Increased access with up to 15 free withdrawals per month.

### ATM fee support
- Receive ATM fee rebates up to 25 each month.

### Statement delivery
- Paper statements are available for Silver Plus Account holders.
- The monthly paper statement fee is $0.00. You can enable paper statements in your account settings.
- Paperless statements are NOT required for this account (unlike Green Account (savings) which requires paperless).

### Relationship benefits
- Earn an additional relationship APY bonus of 0.025% when you qualify under the relationship criteria.

# Bronze Account: Getting interest payments

## How your interest accrues
- Interest compounds daily, so each day's interest is based on your current balance plus any previously accrued interest.

## When you receive interest
- Interest is credited monthly. You will see a single interest credit entry for each crediting period.

## What you will see on your statement
- A transaction line item showing the net interest credited for the period.
- The APY in effect for the period, such as 2.0%, as reflected in your account disclosures.

## Credit card APY bonuses
- Holding certain Rho-Bank credit cards provides bonus APY on your Bronze Account:
  - Bronze Rewards Card: +0.1%
  - Silver Rewards Card: +0%
  - Gold Rewards Card: +0.25%
  - EcoCard: +0%
  - Green Rewards Card: +0.2%
  - Crypto-Cash Back Card: +0.3%

## Tips for verifying interest
- Compare the interest credit to your balance history for the period; fluctuations in balance will affect the credited amount.
- If you opened the account mid-period, the first interest credit will reflect only the days the account was open.

## Where to find the entries
- Review your transaction history for the interest credit posted monthly.

# Diamond Elite Card: Invitation-Only Membership - How to Qualify

## Eligibility at a glance
- Membership is by invitation only (Yes).
- You should maintain a credit score of at least $780 to be considered.

## How invitations are typically extended
- Invitations are sent to clients who demonstrate exceptional creditworthiness and responsible account management.
- A history of timely payments, low credit utilization, and substantial verifiable income increases your likelihood of being invited.
- Relationship depth with Rho-Bank (deposit history, assets under management, and tenure) may be reviewed when invitations are determined.

## Strengthen your candidacy
- Keep your credit utilization well below industry norms to help support a score at or above $780.
- Avoid late or missed payments and minimize recent hard inquiries.
- Maintain steady income documentation and up-to-date contact information so you do not miss an invitation outreach.

## Important notes
- Receiving an invitation is not guaranteed even if your score is at or above $780.
- Invitations are time-limited; respond promptly if you receive one.

# Silver Plus Account: How is interest calculated and when is it paid?

## How your interest works

### Compounding methodology
- Interest is compounded daily, allowing earnings to be calculated frequently based on your daily balance.

### APY tiers
- Your APY depends on your balance tier:
  - Tier 1 APY: 3.0%
  - Tier 2 APY: 4.5%

### Direct deposit bonus
- If you set up direct deposit, your APY increases by an additional 0.25% on top of the base tier for the period in which direct deposit is active.

### Interest crediting schedule
- Accrued interest is credited to your account monthly.

# Platinum Rewards Card: Getting Started with Your Platinum Account

## Activate and Set Up
- Activate your card as soon as it arrives, then add it to your digital wallet for immediate use.
- Set up account alerts for transactions, payments, and unusual activity.

## Understand Your Rates and Limits
- Your purchase APR is 16.99% (variable). Review it in your account details before your first transaction.
- Typical approved credit limits range from $25,000 to $150,000. Your exact limit appears in your approval details.

## Payments and Autopay
- Choose an autopay option (minimum due, statement balance, or custom amount) to avoid interest and fees.
- The minimum monthly payment is 2.5% of your outstanding balance.
- A late payment triggers a fee of $32.50. Set due-date reminders to stay on track.

## Fees to Know on Day One
- Annual fee: $200.00.
- Foreign transaction fee: 0% on international purchases.

## Virtual Cards
- Free virtual cards are included: Yes. Use them to protect your primary card number for online purchases.
- Virtual card management is available in your account: Yes. Create, pause, or delete virtual card numbers as needed.

## First Purchases Checklist
- Confirm your billing address and contact details are current.
- Enroll in alerts and autopay.
- Add your card to frequently used merchants and services.
- Use virtual cards for new online merchants to reduce exposure.

## If You Are Still Applying
- Minimum credit score required: $750.

# Diamond Elite Card: Maximizing Your 5% Rewards on Every Transaction

## Make every eligible dollar count
- Route high-value purchases through your card to capture 5.0%.
- Consolidate recurring bills (subscriptions, utilities, insurance) on your card to steadily build rewards.

## Optimize redemption
- Track your rewards balance and redeem as soon as you meet 5 to turn earnings into statement savings.
- Schedule a monthly review so you do not leave rewards idle.

## Prevent lost rewards
- Ensure autopay or timely manual payments so your account remains in good standing and rewards post as expected.
- Avoid using the card for non-earning transactions (e.g., fees or cash equivalents) that do not generate the 5.0%.

## Monitor and adjust
- Review merchant-level spending monthly to identify opportunities to move additional eligible spend to the card.
- If a transaction posts incorrectly, contact support promptly to review the rewards accrual.

# EcoCard: Apply for a Sustainable Rewards Credit Card

## Eligibility and Requirements
- Minimum credit score required to apply: 0 (0 indicates no credit score requirement).
- You must provide standard identity and income information during the application.

## How to Apply
1. Complete the online application with your personal and financial details.
2. Review the pricing and terms, including fees and interest rates listed below.
3. Submit the application and, if approved, activate your card upon receipt to begin using it.

## Credit Limits Upon Approval
- Initial credit lines are determined at approval and typically range from $5,000 to $50,000.
- Credit line increases may be reviewed over time based on account history and usage.

## Rates and Fees You Agree To
- Purchase APR on carried balances: 19.99%.
- Annual fee: $50.00.
- Foreign transaction fee (international purchases): 1.0%.
- Late payment fee (if you miss the due date): $32.50.

## New-Customer Bonus at Sign-Up
- Spend $5,000 in eligible purchases within your first month to earn $2,000 sustainability points.
- Bonus points are awarded once the threshold is met and the qualifying period closes.

## After You Apply
- You will receive a decision or a request for additional documentation.
- If approved, set up your online account and add your card to a digital wallet to start using it immediately after activation.

# Silver Account: Platinum Rewards Card holder benefits

## Overview

| Balance tier | Balance range | APY |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Below threshold | Less than $10,000 | 2.5% |
| At or above threshold | At least $10,000 | 4.0% |

- Each day, your ending balance is compared to $10,000. If it is below that amount, the applicable APY for that day is 2.5%. If it is at or above that amount, the applicable APY for that day is 4.0%.

- Use balance alerts to help keep your balance at or above $10,000.
